applies_why: The judge text expressly says the Isaiah 7:14 wording was answered by both sides, so the rule governs whether that verse may be counted as an unanswered witness.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: The phrase "If the judge says a verse was answered": it could apply only when the judge expressly counts an unanswered witness, or whenever the judge labels a verse answered; under either reading this text does not count it.
why: Because the text says the verse was answered and does not count it as an unanswered witness, it obeys K-G4.
